description: Giants of living stone asleep in the mountains (server-side with Pandorical)

mods.name: Stone Giants
mods.description: Giants of living stone asleep in the mountains, looking for all the world like an outcrop of rock with a bit of ore showing. Start mining one and it stands up.

releases.notes:
- Giants stay asleep where other worldgen, such as dirt-slab's terracing, reshaped their outcrop, instead of waking on their own and getting stuck in the slabs.
- Rarer: about one for every fifteen chunks of their country, down from ten.
- Every giant wears diamond or emerald on its front, and drops the gem as well as the ore block when it dies.
- Digging near a sleeping giant may wake it: the nearer the block you break, the likelier, out to eight blocks.

mods.name: Stone Giants
mods.description: Giants of living stone asleep in the mountains, looking for all the world like an outcrop of rock with a bit of ore showing. Start mining one and it stands up.

releases.notes:
- Stone giants sleep in the high country and on the stony shores, as an outcrop of the rock around them with a bit of ore showing on its front.
- Five giants, one for each kind of country, each built its own way and sleeping as its own shape of outcrop: the hunched Mossy Giant in the meadows and windswept forests, the lanky Crag Giant on the windswept hills, the eight-and-a-half-block Peak Giant on the stony peaks, the squat, shelled Shore Giant on the stony shores, and the icicle-bearded Frost Giant on the frozen and jagged peaks, snowy slopes and groves.
- Each fights its own way: the mossy giant brawls, the crag giant throws rock from a distance, the frost giant throws ice that freezes, the peak giant stamps the ground, and the shore giant shoves you a long way back.
- Each is about as much stone as the outcrop it slept as, and reels back when you land a blow.
- Start mining any of its stones and it wakes: the rock crumbles away, the giant pushes itself up out of it, and it comes for you.
- A sleeping one gives itself away now and then, with a trickle of grit off its back and a low grind.
- Left a minute with nobody to fight and nobody watching, a giant lies down again wherever it is, turns back to stone, and is healed.
- Killed, it drops cobblestone, a few of its own stone, and the ore it was wearing.
- A spawn egg for each giant, with the other spawn eggs, sets it down asleep.
- Without Pandorical on your client, an awake giant looks like a big iron golem. Asleep it looks like rock to everybody.
